rule: 80% of everything they spent on the item, tax included, in the form they spent it: 80% of the money (and Thrift+ credit) as Thrift+ credit, which never expires, with a cash fallback; 80% of any Rewards used, as Rewards with a fresh 30 days.
title: What they get back
words: 80% of what you spent, tax included, back on your account.
